SELECT A.auction_id, A.judge_kind_name, A.kind, A.title, A.description, A.initial_price, A.buy_now_price, A.grade, A.current_bid_price, A.weight, A.end_date, I.IMAGE_ID, I.IMAGE_URL, U.user_name FROM AUCTIONS A LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMAGES I ON A.auction_id = I.PRODUCT_ID AND I.IS_THUMBNAIL = 'y' INNER JOIN USERS U ON A.seller_id = U.id
WHERE A.auction_status = 'ON'

SELECT A.auction_id, A.judge_kind_name, A.kind, A.title, A.description, A.initial_price, A.buy_now_price, A.grade, A.current_bid_price, A.weight, A.end_date, I.IMAGE_ID, I.IMAGE_URL, U.user_name FROM AUCTIONS A LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMAGES I ON A.auction_id = I.PRODUCT_ID AND I.IS_THUMBNAIL = 'y' INNER JOIN USERS U ON A.seller_id = U.id WHERE A.auction_status = 'ON' AND (A.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR A.description LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')

SELECT S.sale_item_id, S.qty, S.sale_status, S.judge_kind_name, S.title, S.description, S.seller_id, S.cut_name, S.price, S.weight, S.grade, S.traceability_num, S.detail_description, I.IMAGE_ID, I.IMAGE_URL FROM SALES S LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMAGES I ON S.sale_item_id = I.PRODUCT_ID AND I.IS_THUMBNAIL = 'y' INNER JOIN USERS U ON S.seller_id = U.id order by S.created_time
